add-row.note: Inline creation row. It only emits addRowRequest; action buttons in the toolbar stay separate.

ai.prompt: I'm looking at the Solaris UI documentation for {{component}} ({{url}}). Help me understand how to use it. Be ready to explain concepts, give examples, or help debug based on it.

appearance.note: Outline, surface, soft, plain, and grid variants with even or odd striping and frame radius.

basic.note: Text, number, and date columns with optional sorting.

cell-editing.note: Enter or double-click edits in place; Escape closes. Committing values is owned by the consumer.

cell-expand.note: Columns with expandable or a detail template render a chevron next to the value and open a detail row below with only that column.

composition.note: Avatar and badge columns compose existing components through cell templates. Use column.icon for simple header icons without a template.

table.description: Lean data table with sorting, selection, and pluggable states.

examples.note: Start with the default table, then explore sorting, selection, and states below.

footer.note: Aggregates over visible rows rendered in a semantic footer. The gradebook builds its averages on this contract.

header-groups.note: Consecutive columns merge under one group label; ungrouped columns span both rows.

installation.note: Install the single Solaris package, then import the component.

layout.note: Auto sizes columns to content. Full width distributes them across the container.

mobile-composed.note: Phone-width cards composing avatar, badge, and actions with no horizontal dragging.

responsive.note: On mobile (720px and below) priority columns collapse into an expandable detail row in the Actions column. Columns can also carry their own detail template with extra information.

row-dialog.note: Cell buttons open a dialog for quick details without leaving the table.

selection.note: Single swaps the selection, multiple toggles. The header checkbox is tri-state.

server.note: A simulated server owns rows, total, and loading through SolarisTableDataSource.

sorting.note: Click a column header to cycle null, ascending, descending. Changes are announced to screen readers.

states.note: Loading skeletons, empty text, and error alerts. Slots win over plain text.

sticky-column.note: Pins the first column while the table scrolls horizontally, keeping row identity visible.

table.title: Table

wide.note: Wide tables scroll horizontally inside the viewport. Use fullWidth to distribute columns instead.

with-pagination.note: Pagination is projected into the table footer slot, so it shares the table border.

with-tabs.note: Tabs switch datasets while each table keeps its own sort.

with-toolbar.note: Search, filters, saved views, export and column management projected inside the table frame, with pagination in the footer.
